description.en: Opens a folder, a document or a web address chosen by the theme, such as your Documents folder or a project site.
description.zh-CN: 打开主题指定的文件夹、文档或网址，比如“文稿”文件夹或常用网站。

path.description: a folder or file ({desktop}, {documents}, {downloads}, {pictures}, {music}, {videos}, {home}, ~ work) or an https:// address

create.description: create the folder if it does not exist yet
